name: GymFlow - Daily Report to Google Sheets

parameters.query:
with params as (
  select (now() at time zone 'Asia/Dhaka')::date as business_date
),
pay as (
  select
    (p.paid_at at time zone 'Asia/Dhaka')::date as business_date,
    p.amount,
    p.method,
    p.status
  from public.payments p
  where p.paid_at is not null
),
agg as (
  select
    coalesce(sum(amount) filter (where business_date = (select business_date from params)), 0) as collection,
    coalesce(sum(amount) filter (where business_date = (select business_date from params) and method = 'CASH'), 0) as cash,
    coalesce(sum(amount) filter (where business_date = (select business_date from params) and method <> 'CASH'), 0) as online,
    count(*) filter (where business_date = (select business_date from params)) as payments_count
  from pay
  where status = 'SUCCESS'
),
new_members as (
  select count(*) as new_members
  from public.members
  where joined_at = (select business_date from params)
),
renewals as (
  select count(*) as renewals
  from public.memberships m
  where m.start_date = (select business_date from params)
    and exists (
      select 1 from public.memberships prev
      where prev.member_id = m.member_id
        and prev.end_date < m.start_date
    )
),
dues as (
  select coalesce(sum(greatest(ms.fee - coalesce(p.paid, 0) + coalesce(p.refunded, 0), 0)), 0) as dues
  from public.memberships ms
  left join (
    select
      membership_id,
      sum(amount) filter (where status = 'SUCCESS') as paid,
      sum(amount) filter (where status = 'REFUNDED') as refunded
    from public.payments
    group by membership_id
  ) p on p.membership_id = ms.id
  where ms.end_date >= current_date
)
select
  (select business_date from params) as date,
  a.collection,
  a.cash,
  a.online,
  nm.new_members,
  r.renewals,
  a.payments_count,
  d.dues
from agg a, new_members nm, renewals r, dues d;
